F-23B / v1.5

BLACK WIDOW II · PILOT GUIDE · Hornet cockpit and controls

Langley livery. All ten schemes are included.

Use the Hornet MASTER ARM and A/A controls.

1 · TRIGGERA brief press queues release.
2 · BAY OPENSThe correct door clears the store.
3 · WEAPON FIRESOne release per trigger cycle.
4 · BAY CLOSESThe door returns automatically.

Arm and select

Set MASTER ARM to ARM. Select A/A.

Choose AMRAAM for MALICE or Sidewinder for Block II. The Hornet display retains those labels.

AIM-424 MALICE

Designate a valid radar or supported network target. Maintain target updates through midcourse.

The second motor pulse starts at seeker search, after boost burnout. It is held within about 10 seconds of the target.

An earlier build recorded a supported A-50 kill from 336 miles. Motor C has a 58.7-mile fixture hit; its long shot remains unverified. Launch height, speed, target motion and support affect the result.

AIM-9X Block II

Enable IR cooling and obtain a seeker lock before firing. Use the normal trigger.

With a designated hostile aircraft, the seeker locks only that aircraft. Undesignate to let it choose. It does not lock other air-to-air missiles.

Helmet cueing, post-launch datalink and lock-on after launch are not implemented.

SA: 640 NM scale

Open SA on a DDI. Press SCL to cycle through the available scales, including 640 NM (about 737 miles).

Ground handling

Use small steering inputs. Steering authority reduces with speed. Use rudder and differential braking at higher taxi and landing speeds.

AI F-23Bs use the player's engine multipliers; AI top speed in DCS is unverified.

Idle thrust now falls above Mach 1.3 to slow the jet; flight confirmation is pending.

CONNECTION OFF? Custom weapons, radar upgrades and SA 640 are unavailable. Flight, the native cockpit and radar, bays, lights and liveries remain available. Get a compatible release before using custom weapons.
